pins.name: D16
pins.label: D16 (GPIO16)
pins.notes: DCDC Mode Select Pin (output) -- controls the onboard buck-boost regulator's operating mode. Confirmed via official WIZnet docs (docs.wiznet.io/Product/Chip/MCU/W55RP20/w55rp20-evb-pico) and this board's own pins_arduino.h comment ("16u is connected to the buck-boost converted[sic]"). Not general purpose.

pins.name: D17
pins.label: D17 (GPIO17)
pins.notes: Not available -- confirmed via official WIZnet docs ("GPIO17 ... not available due to the connection inside the board"); this board's own pins_arduino.h comment independently notes "17u doesn't even show up in the schematics", consistent with a SiP-internal/unbonded pad.

pins.name: D18
pins.label: D18 (GPIO18)
pins.notes: VBUS sense -- HIGH when VBUS/USB power is present, else LOW, via an onboard voltage divider (confirmed via official WIZnet docs and this board's own pins_arduino.h comment "18u is connected to a voltage divider on VBUS"). Read-only; not one of the RP2040's 4 ADC-capable pins (26-29), so exposed as digital_input, not analog_input. digital_output/pwm_output excluded -- driving this pin fights the sense divider.

pins.name: D19
pins.label: D19 (GPIO19)
pins.notes: PIN_LED / LED_BUILTIN -- onboard user LED (confirmed via official WIZnet docs "Connected to user LED" and this board's own pins_arduino.h comment "19u is connected to USERLED, defined as PIN_LED"). Polarity (active-high vs active-low) could NOT be confirmed from any consulted source -- led_high/led_low intentionally omitted rather than guessed; treat as a plain output pin until independently verified.

pins.name: D20
pins.label: D20 (GPIO20)
pins.notes: Internal-only -- on-package RP2040-to-W5500 PIO-SPI link, chip-select role (WIZnet docs confirm GPIO20 among the "not available" pins; cross-referenced sources identify it as the internal CS line). Not exposed as a header pin.
